answer: Each agent must post a bond tied to one cryptographically verified identity. A verification kernel checks a deposit cannot be reused, and a prism of independent attestations cross-checks uniqueness; every new identity enters through an inlet that charges a real fee. A Sybil attacker must lock fresh collateral for each fake agent, and cheating forfeits it, so the cost scales one-for-one with forged identities while the payoff is split among them.
